title: Cut-off sandwich: ∫ χ_{1−κ,1}(t⁻¹(y−x))β dV ≤ ∫_{Gₙ(B_t(x))} β dV ≤ ∫ χ_{1,1+κ}(t⁻¹(y−x))β dV
statement: Let V be an n-varifold on U ⊆ ℝ^N (V : Varifold N n U), x ∈ ℝ^N, β : G(N,n) → ℝ continuous with β ≥ 0, and κ, t ∈ ℝ with 0 < κ < 1, t > 0 and B_{2t}(x) ⊆ U, where B_r(x) = closedBall x r denotes the closed ball. For w ∈ ℝ^N let χ⁻(w) = max(0, min(1, (1 − |w|)/κ)) and χ⁺(w) = max(0, min(1, (1 + κ − |w|)/κ)). Then ∫ χ⁻(t⁻¹(y − x)) β(S) dV(y,S) ≤ ∫_{B_t(x) × G(N,n)} β(S) dV(y,S) ≤ ∫ χ⁺(t⁻¹(y − x)) β(S) dV(y,S), all integrals being Bochner integrals with respect to V.measure.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U) (x : Euclidean N) (β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ)) (κ t : ℝ), 0 < κ → κ < 1 → 0 < t → closedBall x (2 * t) ⊆ U → (∀ S, 0 ≤ β S) → (∫ z, max 0 (min 1 ((1 - ‖t⁻¹ • (z.1 - x)‖) / κ)) * β z.2 ∂V.measure) ≤ ∫ z in closedBall x t ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure ∧ ∫ z in closedBall x t ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure ≤ ∫ z, max 0 (min 1 ((1 + κ - ‖t⁻¹ • (z.1 - x)‖) / κ)) * β z.2 ∂V.measure
